title: Foundational Models Defining a New Era in Vision: A Survey and Outlook

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature and benchmarks (such as the Visogender dataset) that assess gender bias in vision-language models through tasks like image-text pronoun resolution.
Reviewing literature on how foundational models inherit and amplify biases, stereotypes, and prejudices related to race, underrepresented groups, and minority cultures from large-scale training data.

Highlighting studies that test model sensitivity to visual artifacts, such as demonstrating how drawing a red circle around a person's face in an image spuriously increases the model's likelihood of misclassifying them as a murderer or suspect.
